Source.Title: 雇员同类物品存取
Source.Description: 打开雇员道具栏后，右键按类别批量存取，菜单显示类别和格数。支持鱼和水产品、传送券、魔晶石兑换物、炼金用灵水、布匹、藏宝图，以及九宫幻卡、乐谱、料理等。

English.Title: Retainer Transfers by Item Type
English.Description: Open your retainer’s inventory and right-click an item to deposit or withdraw items of the same type. The menu shows the type and the number of matching slots. Supported types include fish and other seafood, teleport tickets, materia exchange tokens, alchemical waters, textiles, treasure maps, Triple Triad cards, orchestrion rolls, and meals.
